name: CHAOS!!! World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: A double-elimination tournament opened on the fed's own 6 October 1996 relaunch card: Anarchy and the HammerHeads won their winner's-bracket first-round matches, advancing to face former champions Black Rain and former WEW champions Apocalypse respectively, with the surviving record breaking off before the tournament's own conclusion -- the belt still unclaimed when this corpus ends.

name: CHAOS!!! International World Championship
epitaph: "Stunning" Scott Alexander held this belt before the fed's own summer 1996 shutdown; the fed's broadcast team discloses on-air, during the October 1996 relaunch card, that he was stripped of it without the title changing hands in the ring -- left vacant when this corpus ends, also referred to in the same broadcast as the "International Title" and "International Championship."
